identity.name: PRX 40 205
identity.one_liner: The quartz PRX that launched the revival — the cheapest honest way into the integrated-bracelet silhouette.

provenance_events.description: Tissot reissues the 1978 PRX 40 in steel with the integrated bracelet. The 2021 reissue is the first Tissot PRX with a Powermatic 80 automatic movement, at a $700 retail price. The release is the most-cited entry-luxury integrated-bracelet launch of the 2020s.

narrative.story: The PRX launched in 2021 as this quartz reference, reviving the 1978 Seastar Quartz case shape to a reception Tissot itself did not anticipate. The automatic followed on the same case, but the quartz remains the entry point: the same tonneau case, integrated bracelet, and dial discipline at a price where a mistake costs a dinner, not a holiday.
narrative.collector_notes: Thinner than the Powermatic version and arguably truer to the 1978 original. If the ticking seconds hand bothers you, that is the sign to spend up for the automatic.
